//: The JVM parity runner's books (card A-22, docs/plans/android-assessment.md §5.4; the rules are in player/parity/jvm-pending.js). runs: the families the JVM has a runner for (JvmFamilies.ALL), which since A-63 is every recorded family that is not jsOnly. A-63 ported the last owed family (manager-remainder) and the last owed case (contract/send-request-valid-set-route-sharing-long-form) and retired owing, as NE-39s retired swift-pending.json and unported.json: there is no families or cases key any more, record.mjs --check is red if either comes back (even empty) or a recorded family that is not jsOnly is missing from runs, record.mjs refuses --jvm-card, and the JVM loader (ParityData) refuses a tree that owes. So a JS change that records a new family carries its JVM runner (and its runs entry) in the same change, and a re-recorded case in a family the JVM runs is held by the JVM runner (android-build) until its port lands in that change. jsOnly families are never run.
